changes: The daily official-source snapshot was refreshed on 2026-06-08 UTC and rolled the canonical watch forward to current repo, release, and README state across the tracked set.
AstrBot shipped a fresh adjacent-platform release, v4.25.5, published at 2026-06-07 17:26:28 UTC.
PicoClaw posted a new nightly build, published at 2026-06-08 01:34:04 UTC, which keeps the lightweight / cheap-hardware lane active.
OpenClaw itself did not post a newer release after v2026.6.5-beta.2 from 2026-06-07 00:26:39 UTC.
The monitored set, taxonomy, and canonical references remain unchanged, including Hermes Agent at https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.
whyItMatters: This was a real but not thesis-changing movement day: there was fresh release activity around the ecosystem, but not from the category anchor itself.
AstrBot continuing to ship matters because it reinforces adjacent IM-agent platform competition, especially on plugin-heavy, chat-native deployment.
PicoClaw nightlies matter as a signal that the lightweight edge-device lane is still active, but they do not change the strategic map by themselves.
The right call is to refresh the volatile day layer and hosted dataset, while leaving the stable taxonomy and executive digest unchanged.
